content_sections.heading: Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: Candidates should possess the prescribed Higher Secondary or equivalent qualification with the required marks along with a teacher-training qualification such as: Two-year Diploma in Elementary Education Four-year Bachelor of Elementary Education Two-year Diploma in Education or Special Education, where applicable Candidates should possess a Bachelor’s degree with the required teacher-training qualification. Depending on the applicable eligibility route, accepted qualifications include: Bachelor’s degree with B.Ed. Higher Secondary with four-year B.El.Ed. Higher Secondary with four-year BA.Ed. or B.Sc.Ed. Other equivalent qualifications recognized under the applicable NCTE and Kerala Government rules Candidates should possess the prescribed Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in the relevant subject along with B.Ed., MSc.Ed. or another recognized teacher-training qualification applicable to High School teaching. Category 4 is intended for language teachers, specialist teachers and Physical Education teachers. Candidates must possess the qualification prescribed for the relevant teaching post under Kerala Education Department rules. Applicants should check the category-wise qualification and equivalency conditions in the official notification before submitting the application.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The examination fee must be paid online using the payment options provided on the application portal, including net banking, credit card or debit card.

content_sections.heading: KTET Exam Pattern
content_sections.text: Each KTET category contains 150 multiple-choice questions for 150 marks. The category-wise syllabus and distribution of questions vary according to the teaching level.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KTET September 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official KTET website at ktet.kerala.gov.in . Open the KTET September 2026 online application link. Select “New Registration.” Read the application instructions carefully. Enter the required personal, educational and category details. Select the KTET category or categories for which you are eligible. Upload the prescribed photograph and other required files. Check all entered information before confirming the application. Pay the examination fee through the available online payment option. Complete the final submission by 3 October 2026. Download and retain the final application printout and transaction details. Applications are accepted only online. Candidates are not required to send the application printout or certificate copies to Kerala Pareeksha Bhavan.

content_sections.heading: Photograph Requirements
content_sections.text: The photograph must be recent and clear. The background should meet the specifications prescribed in the notification. The applicant’s face must be clearly visible. The photograph must be uploaded in the prescribed format and file size. Candidates should not upload an unclear or unsuitable photograph.

content_sections.heading: KTET Hall Ticket 2026
content_sections.text: The KTET September 2026 hall ticket will be available from 4 November 2026. Candidates must download it from the official KTET website using their application credentials. The hall ticket will contain the examination centre, reporting time and candidate-specific instructions. A printed hall ticket must be carried to the examination centre.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates must check their category-wise eligibility before applying. Separate examinations are conducted for Categories 1, 2, 3 and 4. Eligible candidates may apply for more than one category by paying the applicable fee. Applications can be submitted only through the official online portal. Candidates must carefully verify all information before confirming the application. Changes may not be permitted after final confirmation. The final application printout and payment transaction details should be retained. The examination will be conducted using OMR answer sheets. Candidates should regularly check the official websites for updates.

faq.question: Q1. When will the KTET September 2026 application process start?
faq.answer: The online application process will begin on 23 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for KTET September 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online and pay the examination fee is 3 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. When will the KTET examinations be held?
faq.answer: Category 1 and Category 2 exams will be held on 14 November 2026. Category 3 and Category 4 exams will be held on 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the KTET application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹500 for general and other candidates. SC, ST and differently-abled candidates must pay ₹250.

faq.question: Q5. How many KTET categories are available?
faq.answer: There are four categories: Category 1, Category 2, Category 3 and Category 4.

faq.question: Q6. How many questions are asked in the KTET examination?
faq.answer: Each KTET paper contains 150 multiple-choice questions carrying a total of 150 marks.

faq.question: Q7. What is the duration of the KTET examination?
faq.answer: The duration of each KTET examination is two and a half hours.

faq.question: Q8. What are the qualifying marks for general-category candidates?
faq.answer: General-category candidates must obtain at least 60%, which is 90 marks out of 150.
